summary: Phase S1 is accepted: the four frozen v2 packages are present under neutral scopes, behavior-bearing source equivalence is proven, provider/dependency/export boundaries pass, provenance and mechanical deviations are auditable, and no v3 algorithm behavior entered the import.
nonblocking_findings: S1-ACCEPTANCE-001 [medium]: Retained ra-math repository-harness assertions remain red because their repository-level specifications, Measure documents, boundary scripts, CI workflow, or pre-ESM source shapes are not part of this monorepo import. The imported engine-behavior surface is source-equivalent; future test-governance work should separate portable package behavior tests from source-repository conformance tests.

S1-ACCEPTANCE-002 [medium]: The frozen srs-engine suite contains a documented one-millisecond Date.now boundary flake; the review reproduced 232/233 after a prior Green run observed 233/233. Deterministic clocks are required for new v3.2 fixtures in Phase S2.

S1-ACCEPTANCE-003 [low]: pnpm-lock.yaml is shared, already dirty, and excluded from the scoped remediation commits. Phase integration must verify frozen-lock consistency without overwriting unrelated lockfile work.
S1-ACCEPTANCE-004 [low]: srs-engine and practice-core package-root README coverage is deferred to Phase S4 governance/documentation.
evidence: Story S1 criterion 1: knowledge-space-core, knowledge-space-practice, srs-engine, and practice-core are workspace packages with retained source tests; package builds/check-types pass, engine-bearing behavior is source-equivalent, and nonportable retained harness failures are explicitly classified in the correctness audit and plan evidence.

Story S1 criterion 2: 199 frozen source paths map one-to-one to 199 destination paths. After approved scope, ESM specifier, explicit directory-index, and workspace configuration normalization, all 183 non-configuration files have zero unexplained differences; provenance lists five non-algorithm configuration/dependency deviations.

Story S1 criterion 3: the provider/dependency boundary audit passes. Production source has no React, Next, Vinext, Drizzle, Convex, Firebase, Prisma, transport, AI-provider, auth, storage, environment, tenant, or secret coupling; every bare production import is directly declared and relative imports use .js ESM specifiers.

Story S1 criterion 4: import-provenance.json records source repository and commit, all four source tree IDs, kst-srs.v2 normative specification repository, same-owner/no-license-file classification, inventories, normalized comparison method, and every mechanical deviation.

The final focused acceptance run passed 10/10 and built every package, verified every runtime/declaration export target, dynamically loaded 30 exports, enforced neutral dependencies, and checked package provenance.
Correctness, provider/dependency boundary, and public API/package-DX audits all report pass with empty blocking, test-strategy, live-contract, production-wiring, and route-parity violation arrays.
Remediation commit c23dc536 removed two inherited manifest exports with no source/build target and strengthened runtime/declaration export validation.
Remediation commit 60397049 declared srs-engine's direct Zod dependency and strengthened inverse production-dependency validation.
UX browser review is not applicable: Phase S1 changes framework-neutral packages and exposes no user interface or route.
